title: OpenClaw Part 4 - Advanced Tips & Power User

slides.text:
Part 4. The <accent>final</accent> part.

You've set it up. You know the features.
Now let's unlock the <accent>advanced</accent> workflows
that separate casual users from power users.

slides.heading: Tip 1: <accent>VPS</accent> Deployment
slides.body:
Move OpenClaw off your laptop.
Deploy to a $5/month VPS.
Now it runs 24/7, even when you sleep.

slides.heading: Top 5 <accent>Skills</accent> to Install
items: Capability Evolver - agents that improve themselves
GitHub Integration - code review and PR automation
Web Researcher - deep research with citations

slides.heading: Tip 2: <accent>Cron</accent> Jobs
slides.body:
Schedule recurring tasks.
Daily standup summaries.
Weekly report generation.
All automated.

terminal.text: You: Every Friday at 5pm, generate a weekly summary
Weekly summary will arrive every Friday.

slides.heading: Tip 3: Custom <accent>Skills</accent>
slides.body:
Build your own skills.
Package them. Share on ClawHub.
Turn your workflows into reusable tools.

slides.heading: The <accent>Big Picture</accent>
slides.body:
- OpenClaw is not a toy. It's infrastructure.
- Deploy it like you'd deploy any service.
- Specialize your agents. Automate your life.
- The developers who master this early win.
